repos_data.description: Cleanlab's open-source library is the standard data-centric AI package for data quality and machine learning with messy, real-world data and labels.

Offline desktop image annotation tool (PyQt6): bbox, polygon, OBB, keypoints, brush masks, semantic & panoptic segmentation. Exports YOLO (detect/seg/OBB/pose), COCO (instances/RLE/keypoints/panoptic), Pascal VOC, LabelMe, semantic masks.
